newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain launches bidding for Telefonica Intl stake.
newsitem.headline: Spain launches bidding for Telefonica Intl stake.

text.p: Spanish state holding group Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Patrimoniales (SEPPa) announced on Monday the launch of bidding for its 23.78 percent of Telefonica Internacional (TISA) with newspaper advertisements.
The tender is open to financial institutions, non-financial entities, portfolio managers and institutional investors, the advertisements said.
The advert refers interested parties to lead manager Dresdner Kleinwort Benson. Bidding closes on August 8.
Early in June, SEPPa said it would tender for the privatisation of the 23.78 percent of TISA not in the hands of telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana.
Telefonica is not participating in the tender, but has an option to buy the stake by matching the best offer.
The state finished privatising the parent Telefonica in February, selling off its remaining 21 percent stake in a hugely successful public share offer.
